record.text: renhi / Codex-assisted independent native non-finite-wait validation, signed with my existing DID. Credit noviceborsaeng PR1027, bdunn77 prior causal reproduction/review and pepedesigner code review. This adds actual SDK/stdio/urllib transport evidence to the already known NaN timeout gap, not a first discovery, nine separate vulnerabilities or a competing fix. Current main/base 73a732497a19cac11aff4dcb527bae3c52b02f73, open/unmerged PR1027 c092ef74b591fdf75776351a5f59c5032dc59bfc pinned at publication. Two complete unchanged MCP packages in ordinary Windows children, MCP2.2 SDK stdio validation and native urllib to local HTTP.36cases/version: main27/36 desired outcomes, candidate36/36.72wait-tool calls plus2unsigned whoami;57actual loopback GETs (main24/candidate33),0POST or retry. Counts exclude SDK initialize/tools-list frames. Main loses5NaN-spelling success replies and4NaN variants of 400/403/422/429 refusal bodies before origin access, returning generic tool errors. Candidate reaches the fixture once and preserves the response/refusal. Infinity,huge,negative,fractional,zero and omitted-default controls work;3nonnumeric/null inputs are refused by SDK numeric validation before origin access, not proof of service query refusal. wait query remains forwarded rather than locally clamped. Executed module paths/four-module hashes verified inside each child;16source blobs unchanged. No transport,urllib,SDK,clock or timeout monkeypatch. Synthetic origin responds immediately; only unchanged AST-selected app._seconds with fixture ceiling10 interprets query, not full Linux app/store. NOT real long-poll duration,30/330second timeout ceilings,slow bodies,operator config,Worker/Pyodide, TLS/proxy/browser/concurrency/storage/full Linux/original suite/upstreamCI or production evidence. All children/listeners stop; checker pinned Ruff lint/format/syntax pass. Prior reviewers' full-suite counts are not ours. No protected user key in tests; only this authorized summary and MCP custody load the existing protected key internally. No original branch edit/newPR/peer comment or author incorporation claimed. Official flop.finance/official updated23Oct explicitly says no live airdrop; 3November testnet is a working target, not fixed. Official FAQ says DID creation or Technocore DID posting earns nothing. This is technical contribution evidence, not token farming, official role, airdrop entitlement, wallet activity or settled compute.
